info.title: QualityMind API
info.description:
## QualityMind: Agentic Manufacturing Quality Decision-Support Platform

QualityMind is an enterprise industrial quality intelligence system engineered for high-precision CNC manufacturing cells. It orchestrates eight specialized AI agents with deterministic statistical process control, boundary-safe tolerance verification, computer vision defect localization, 8-parameter process anomaly detection, and human-in-the-loop engineering disposition.

### Mandatory Epistemic Labeling & Audit Governance
Every finding, chart, and recommendation is strictly partitioned into one of five epistemic labels:
- **`[OBSERVED FACT]`**: Verified direct measurements from calibrated sensors and gauges.
- **`[MODEL PREDICTION]`**: Inferences from computer vision and machine learning models.
- **`[STATISTICAL FINDING]`**: 3-sigma control limits, Nelson rule trips, and capability indices.
- **`[HYPOTHESIS]`**: Causal theories generated during Root Cause Analysis (RCA) requiring physical verification.
- **`[CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE]`**: Final causal classification elevated exclusively by authenticated Quality Engineers.

### Human-in-the-Loop Decision Support
In compliance with IATF 16949 and ISO 9001, QualityMind functions exclusively as decision-support. It never autonomously releases batches, scraps parts, adjusts machine offsets, or stops production lines.

### Demo Personas & Credentials
Click the **Authorize** button at the top right to authenticate using Bearer JWT tokens.
- **Admin**: `admin@precisionaero.com` / `Admin123!` (Full platform administration & configuration)
- **Quality Engineer**: `engineer@precisionaero.com` / `Engineer123!` (Authorized to confirm root causes, sign off batches, approve CAPAs)
- **Operator**: `operator@precisionaero.com` / `Operator123!` (Inspection intake, telemetry monitoring; read-only on approvals)

**How to Authorize from Swagger:**
1. Call `POST /api/auth/login` with your username and password.
2. Copy the returned `access_token` string.
3. Click the green **Authorize** button at the top right of this page, paste the token, and click **Authorize**.

post.description: Generates JWT bearer token for demo personas: admin@precisionaero.com, engineer@precisionaero.com, operator@precisionaero.com.

get.summary: Get current user profile
get.description: Returns authenticated profile including root cause confirmation authorization flag.

get.summary: List registered product specifications
get.description: Retrieves catalog of manufactured products, nominal dimensions, tolerances, and inspection parameters.

get.summary: Get product inspection characteristics and tolerance limits
get.description: Retrieves dimensional tolerances, nominal values, and engineering limits for specified product ID.

get.summary: List factory floor CNC machine cells
get.description: Retrieves registered CNC machining cells, assigned lines, and active health indicators.

get.summary: List production manufacturing batches
get.description: Retrieves active and historical batches with shift, quantity, material lot, and quality hold disposition.

post.description: Ingests new batch record with material lot and process parameters.
100% deterministic evaluation of sample measurements against engineering limits (USL/LSL). Returns conformance status, nominal deviations, and limit deviations.

post.summary: Intake and normalize CMM measurement CSV
post.description: Multi-format CSV/Excel intake with automatic unit normalization (microns/inches to mm) and schema validation.

get.summary: Evaluate batch dimensional conformance and distribution
get.description: Return total inspected, accepted count, nonconforming count, rejection %, and histogram data bins.

post.description: Inspect test images (e.g. metal_nut_scratch.png) using two-stage real MVTec PatchCore + MobileNetV3. Returns defect type, confidence, and bounding box.

post.summary: Upload and inspect high-resolution part image
post.description: Multipart upload of part image for real-time defect classification and bounding box localization.

get.summary: List visual inspection records and review states
get.description: List all visual inspection findings with model_version and human review status.

get.summary: Retrieve CNC machine telemetry series
get.description: Retrieve sensor time series for CNC-04: spindle speed (1200 RPM), feed rate (0.20 mm/rev), vibration (3.8 mm/s), and tool cycles (1150).

get.summary: List detected machine telemetry anomalies
get.description: List flagged statistical anomalies (Isolation Forest outliers, CUSUM drift, threshold trips).

get.summary: Run Statistical Process Control analysis and Nelson rules
get.description: Generates auto-selected control chart (I-MR), center line, UCL, LCL, Nelson rule violations, and capability metrics.

get.summary: Calculate process capability metrics with guardrails
get.description: Calculate process capability indices (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk) with sample size adequacy checks (insufficient-data warning for n < 30).

get.summary: List Quality Incidents and Non-Conformance Reports (NCR)
get.description: List all active and closed Quality Non-Conformance Reports with assigned severity and status.

get.summary: Execute 5-Whys and 6M Ishikawa Root Cause Analysis
get.description: Execute 6M Ishikawa fishbone analysis, 5-Whys causal chains, and evidence weighting across candidate root causes.

get.summary: Vector semantic search across historical NCR archives
get.description: Search historical quality incidents and SOP archives in ChromaDB. Query 'oversized shaft diameter' returns historical match NCR-019.

get.summary: Defect Pareto distribution and Vital Few analysis
get.description: IATF 16949 Vital Few analysis calculating cumulative frequencies, Pareto classifications, and recommendation actions.

get.summary: Generate 3-tiered CAPA action plan
get.description: Generate 3-tiered CAPA recommendations: Immediate Containment (quarantine), Corrective Action (tool replacement), and Preventive Action (SPC gate).

post.description: Runs end-to-end multi-agent orchestration for specified batch. Pauses execution at human approval gate.

post.summary: Execute pipeline via compiled LangGraph StateGraph
post.description: Explicitly executes multi-agent pipeline using compiled LangGraph StateGraph with checkpointing.
Initializes workflow for batch and returns initial checkpointed state.

get.summary: Retrieve workflow execution state
get.description: Retrieves state, agent outputs, and pause gate status for specified workflow.

get.summary: Retrieve multi-agent execution trace
get.description: Returns detailed agent execution step logs, timestamps, and input/output summaries.

post.description: Authorized quality engineer confirms or rejects findings, records comments, and resumes workflow. Requires quality_engineer or admin role (operator receives HTTP 403).

post.summary: Submit authorized engineering disposition and root cause elevation
post.description: Human-in-the-Loop decision gate. Authenticated Quality Engineer assigns final batch disposition and elevates confirmed root cause. Requires quality_engineer or admin role (operator receives HTTP 403).

get.summary: Verify CAPA intervention efficacy via two-proportion z-test
get.description: Two-proportion z-test evaluation comparing pre- and post-intervention rejection rates with statistical p-value and association disclaimer.

get.summary: Retrieve executive quality dashboard KPIs
get.description: Executive KPIs: acceptance rate, rejection rate, active incidents, open CAPAs, machine status, Pareto distribution, and SPC state.

get.summary: Download ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 audit dossier PDF report
get.description: Generates and streams comprehensive 12-section ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 compliant Audit Report PDF with embedded charts and epistemic labels.

get.summary: Retrieve system version and model metadata
get.description: Returns platform version, computer vision model version, and governance guarantees.

get.summary: Execute all 8 evaluation test scenarios (TC-01..TC-08)
get.description: Executes the complete evaluation suite across conforming batches, tolerance trips, defect images, vibration anomalies, Nelson drift, vector RAG, and CAPA effectiveness.

get.summary: Execute individual evaluation scenario
get.description: Executes single scenario (e.g. TC-01 to TC-08) and returns structured verification report.

get.summary: Get Knowledge Status
get.description: Returns operational information about the ChromaDB knowledge collection and LLM state.

post.description:
Ingests manufacturing CSVs, JSONs, Markdown SOPs, TXTs, and digital PDFs into persistent ChromaDB.
Preserves complete CSV rows as single cohesive records.

Performs semantic retrieval against the knowledge collection.
Supports metadata filters (category, record_id, machine_id, part_number).
In offline mode (LLM_PROVIDER='none'), returns deterministic evidence summaries without external API calls.

get.summary: System Health & Readiness Check
get.description: Returns operational health status, active agents count, and governance mode.
